# Shopyor

> Shopyor is a free online toolbox: 20+ browser-based tools for downloading
> video, converting and compressing PDFs and images, cloning a voice, building
> a resume, calculating BMI, and generating SEO tags â€” no sign-up, no install.

All tools run client-side or through a privacy-respecting backend with no
permanent storage of uploaded files. Every tool page below includes a
description, step-by-step instructions, and an FAQ section.

## Tools

- [PDF to Word Converter](https://www.shopyor.com/tools/convert-your-pdf-file-to-word): Convert PDF to editable Word (DOCX), with OCR for scanned files.
- [PDF Compressor](https://www.shopyor.com/tools/compress-your-pdf-file): Reduce PDF file size while keeping quality.
- [AI Background Remover](https://www.shopyor.com/tools/background-remover-image): Remove image backgrounds automatically and export a transparent PNG.
- [Image Compressor](https://www.shopyor.com/tools/image-compressor): Compress JPG, PNG, and WebP images without visible quality loss.
- [EXIF Metadata Remover](https://www.shopyor.com/tools/exif-remover): Strip hidden EXIF and GPS metadata from photos.
- [Video Downloader](https://www.shopyor.com/tools/video-downloader): Download videos from Facebook, Instagram, or TikTok.
- [Facebook Video Downloader](https://www.shopyor.com/tools/facebook-video-downloader): Download public Facebook videos and Reels in HD.
- [Instagram Video Downloader](https://www.shopyor.com/tools/instagram-video-downloader): Save public Instagram Reels and videos.
- [TikTok Video Downloader](https://www.shopyor.com/tools/free-tiktok-video-downloader): Download TikTok videos without a watermark.
- [AI Voice Cloner](https://www.shopyor.com/tools/voice-clone): Clone a voice from a short sample and generate speech from text.
- [BMI Calculator](https://www.shopyor.com/tools/bmi): Calculate Body Mass Index in metric or imperial units, with a healthy-weight chart.
- [Amazon Affiliate Link Generator](https://www.shopyor.com/tools/affiliate-link-generator): Convert an Amazon URL or ASIN into a tagged affiliate link.
- [YouTube Thumbnail Downloader](https://www.shopyor.com/tools/youtube-thumbnail): Download full-resolution thumbnails from any YouTube video.
- [YouTube Tags Extractor](https://www.shopyor.com/tools/youtube-tags-extractor): Extract the hidden tags from any YouTube video.
- [Meta Tag Generator](https://www.shopyor.com/tools/meta-tag-generator): Generate SEO title, description, and Open Graph meta tags.
- [Robots.txt Generator](https://www.shopyor.com/tools/robots-txt-generator): Create a correct robots.txt file, including AI-crawler rules.
- [All tools](https://www.shopyor.com/tools): Full, current list of every free tool on Shopyor.
